completion_policy: Record scope, source, search date, exact query, items discovered, verified/visited count and each item’s disposition. “Not found” requires a recorded bounded search and must not be converted into proof of non-existence.

required_actions: enumerate all current Croatian missions from live directory
map each consular jurisdiction to visa submission mission
check mission-specific family-member visa instructions and local language
check appointment route, checklist, fee, submission channel, processing/outsourcing provider
record dated page/version evidence and changes; never infer from one mission sample
enumerate current police administrations and their territorial jurisdiction from MUP official pages
map EEA residence registration/card service and competent location for each territory
check appointments, accepted submission channels, local forms/checklists and evidence practices
record publication date and compare local guidance with EEA Act/regulation
resolve whether any practice is national-only or varies locally
run the 40 planned court/topic queries in case-law-discovery.json using portal filters
record exact query, court, date, result count, every screened result, duplicates and exclusion reasons
read every relevant decision and record holding, outcome, procedural posture, provisions and applicability
repeat searches and compare decision IDs on the maintenance schedule
check MUP and MVEP parent indexes for a newer government-published consolidated edition and any specifically identified material update on each review
track EEA Act/regulation and all material EU references separately
record legal effects of invalidity, replacement, transition and commencement dates
use the official parent index to identify the latest edition; consult individual Gazette acts only for a specific gap or commencement question
rediscover every form and attachment from current parent page
inspect native PDFs visually and compare purpose/version against rule
record dead/replaced links and statutory source authority
resolve current URLs from MUP forms parent and reconcile its amendment citation with the MUP legislation index
inspect Form 4b and 11b image annexes and verify post-3 August 2026 card format and issuance
observations: MUP live forms index lists Forms 1b, 2b, 3b and 6b but cites an EEA regulation chain without NN 155/22, which appears in the MUP legislation index.
NN 86/21 includes Forms 4b and 11b as residence-card specimens; these are distinct from Form 2b. Both specimens and currently issued cards remain visually unreviewed.
